```dafny
newtype Cents = x: int | -0x8000_0000 <= x < 0x8000_0000

method Debit(balance: Cents, amount: Cents) returns (remaining: Cents)
  requires balance >= 0
  requires 0 <= amount <= balance
  ensures remaining == balance - amount
  ensures remaining >= 0
{
  remaining := balance - amount;
}
```
